apresentacao.titulo: It is a pleasure to meet you. I am Olivia.
apresentacao.p1: For over 20 years I have had the privilege of working as a tour guide in Rio de Janeiro, a job I do with a great deal of passion, dedication and care.
apresentacao.p2: I believe a great tour goes far beyond visiting the main sights. I want you to feel so comfortable and so well looked after that, at the end of the day, we say goodbye with a hug, like old friends.

comoTrabalho.titulo: Every itinerary is built from scratch
comoTrabalho.p1: I work mainly with private, tailor made tours, planned around your interests, your pace and the kind of experience you want to have in Rio.
comoTrabalho.p2: You do not have to pick a ready made itinerary. Tell me what you enjoy: nature, city life, the famous sights, culture or local experiences. Tell me how much time you have as well. I will put together a tour especially for you.
comoTrabalho.p3: Every traveler is different, and I believe everyone's experience of Rio should be different too.

equipe.p1: Along the way I have built a small team of guides who work with me. I chose each of them carefully, because I recognized in them the same qualities I consider essential in my own work: commitment, responsibility, warmth and, above all, a genuine love of welcoming people and sharing our city with them.
equipe.p2: They are professionals I trust completely, and they work the way I do, with care, attention and a real commitment to making every experience special.
equipe.p3: Between me and the team, we welcome travelers in Portuguese, English, Spanish, French and Italian. Tell me which language you would rather be guided in and I will arrange the right person for your day.

itens.pergunta: How do I ask for a quote?
itens.resposta: Message me on WhatsApp with the dates of your trip, the number of people and what you would like to see. With that I put together a suggested itinerary and send you the price.

itens.pergunta: What affects the price of a tour?
itens.resposta: The size of the group, the length of the tour, the transport you choose and the tickets for the attractions in the itinerary. That is why I prefer to quote each trip individually instead of publishing a price list.
The quote always says what is included and what is paid separately. Attractions such as Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf have their own tickets, and I can buy them for you if you prefer.
We arrange everything on WhatsApp before the tour. I explain the payment options available and confirm the booking with you.

itens.pergunta: What if I need to cancel?
itens.resposta: Let me know as early as you can. I understand that travel plans change, and I will always look for a solution, whether that means moving the date or adjusting the itinerary.
I usually pick you up at your hotel or wherever you are staying. If you prefer another meeting point, we agree on it beforehand.

itens.pergunta: Is it safe to go around Rio?
itens.resposta: With planning, yes. I know the city, I choose the times and the routes, and I am with you throughout. That is one of the reasons to see Rio with a local guide.
Of course. I adapt the pace, the distances and the stops to the age of the children. Tell me their ages and I will build an itinerary that works for the whole family.
